description: Source code for Exotel media stream serializer in Pipecat, handling WebSocket protocol conversion, audio resampling, and DTMF event processing.

classes.name: ExotelFrameSerializer
classes.description: Serializer for Exotel Media Streams WebSocket protocol, converting Pipecat frames to/from Exotel's WebSocket media stream protocol.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Configures the serializer with pipeline settings based on StartFrame.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Converts Pipecat frames into Exotel WebSocket messages, handling media, interruption, and transport frames.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Converts Exotel WebSocket messages into Pipecat frames, handling media and DTMF events.
